mapper.select: SELECT FROM pmis_flow_delegate_auth WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0 AND auth_status = 'ENABLED' AND start_time <= #{now} AND end_time >= #{now} AND ( (scope_type = 'FLOW_NODE' AND flow_code = #{flowCode} AND node_code = #{nodeCode}) OR (scope_type = 'FLOW' AND flow_code = #{flowCode}) OR (scope_type = 'ALL') ) ORDER BY CASE scope_type WHEN 'FLOW_NODE' THEN 1 WHEN 'FLOW' THEN 2 WHEN 'ALL' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END ASC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM pmis_flow_delegate_auth WHERE deleted = 0 AND auth_status = 'ENABLED' AND end_time < #{now} ORDER BY end_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
